threshold_interpretation: Provisional engineering loss budget of one percentage point per metric, not a literature-derived universal threshold.
timing_disclosure: Defined after observing the 50-image candidate pilots and the existing FP32 development baseline, before the candidate's 1000-image evaluation. The pilot is included in development.
pass_means: Eligible for further screening-method development, not proof of equivalence or final deployment suitability.
fail_action: Record the result and revise the candidate or scope through an explicit amendment; do not silently relax the thresholds.
limitations: Point-estimate gate does not establish statistical non-inferiority.
Development evaluation is not an independent final test.
Weight-only logical INT8 uses FP32 computation.
